_comment: Claude Code themes pfm install places into ~/.claude/themes/ (a user-level dir, shared by every project; the fleet accounts share it too when their themes/ dirs are symlinked). Two kinds. source_fetched: fetched at install from the theme's canonical public repo, always latest — the blueprint never vendors a copy. bundled: palettes the blueprint ships itself as `file` beside this manifest, read from the source clone or downloaded from beside the release manifest. Both kinds are recorded in the install ownership ledger. Activate with /theme, or set `theme` in an account's settings.json.

professor-gold.activate: /theme → "Professor Gold — blazing gold on deep indigo, hot-pink ask — noon sun" — the 🥇 account 1 palette; per account: "theme": "custom:professor-gold" in that account's settings.json

professor-silver.activate: /theme → "Professor Silver — chrome on midnight navy, electric-blue ask, acid-green success — lightning" — the 🥈 account 2 palette; per account: "theme": "custom:professor-silver" in that account's settings.json

professor-bronze.activate: /theme → "Professor Bronze — molten bronze on dark maroon, hot-pink ask — lava lamp" — the 🥉 account 3 palette; per account: "theme": "custom:professor-bronze" in that account's settings.json
